crossRefs.note: Woe to those who devise iniquity and work evil on their beds! When the morning is light, they practice it, because it…
He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”
Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence…
If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? Nevertheless we didn’t use this right, but we bear all…
Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed…
We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ…
Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain,
Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,
yet for love’s sake I rather beg, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
Then I consulted with myself, and contended with the nobles and the rulers, and said to them, “You exact usury…
“If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not…
he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall…
he who hasn’t lent to them with interest, hasn’t taken any increase from them, who has withdrawn his hand from…
has lent with interest, and has taken increase from the poor; shall he then live? He shall not live. He has done all…

translations.web: I likewise, my brothers and my servants, lend them money and grain. Please let us stop this usury.
translations.bsb: I, as well as my brothers and my servants, have been lending the people money and grain. Please, let us stop this usury.
translations.kjv: I likewise, and my brethren, and my servants, might exact of them money and corn: I pray you, let us leave off this usury.
translations.asv: And I likewise, my brethren and my servants, do lend them money and grain. I pray you, let us leave off this usury.
